result.title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
result.comment: perovskite solar cells, provenance-grouped protocol, state of art, benchmark
result.summary: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication. Because nearly two-thirds of curated devices share their exact recipe with another, random splits primarily reward the mere recall of historical data rather than testing true physical generalisation. To solve this, we mapped the institutional provenance of the Perovskite Database and established a rigorous hierarchy of grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications, and institutions. Benchmarking thirteen models establishes new state-of-the-art performance across all splits and reveals a critical regime shift: while tree ensembles dominate random splits by recognising familiar recipes, their ranking collapses on genuinely unseen institutions and future discoveries, where composition-aware neural architectures excel. Furthermore, feature importance demonstrates that the device architecture and fabrication methodology dictate final efficiency just as strongly as the absorber chemistry. This standardised protocol empowers the community to separate memorisation from true physical discovery.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出钙钛矿太阳能电池的机器学习数据集因大量近乎重复的配方而存在严重泄漏，随机划分主要奖励对历史数据的记忆；作者据此按机构来源构建分级分组划分协议，基准测试13个模型，发现树集成在随机划分下领先但在未见机构与未来数据上排序崩塌，而组成感知的神经网络架构更稳健。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心方法线索是「按数据来源分组划分以区分记忆与真实泛化」，可供核查是否适用于 LVR 推理基准的重复轨迹泄漏诊断与泛化评价；但对象为材料科学表格数据，与视觉推理的状态生成机制无直接关联。
